episodes.title: Why Do People Dance?
episodes.summary: In the midst of an era of conflict, Oniyasha wrestles with a question he cannot answer.

episodes.title: You Have a Body
episodes.summary: Fascinated by the woman's haunting performance, Oniyasha seeks her out and requests to watch her dance again.

episodes.title: You Have Your Own Sense of "Good"
episodes.summary: The Kanze Troupe has a once-in-a-lifetime chance to perform for the shogun, but it's an opportunity that weighs heavily on Oniyasha's shoulders.

episodes.title: Differing Scales of Progress
episodes.summary: As the Kanze Troupe takes the stage at Imakumano, Oniyasha gains a new perspective on both his father and the shogun.

episodes.title: A Budding Throb
episodes.summary: Two rival troupes hold a competition, and the stakes couldn't be higher. The losing troupe must forfeit the shogun's patronage and disband.

episodes.title: Connection
episodes.summary: Oniyasha gets a second chance, but he'll have to regain his confidence before facing Zojiro again.

episodes.title: In Between
episodes.summary: Oniyasha and Kogane struggle to accept Toku's fate.

episodes.title: To the Other Side of the Bridge
episodes.summary: Oniyasha's stunning performance compels Zojiro to concede defeat. Yet the competition continues, and both performers are forced to face their own limitations.

episodes.title: Concealed Feelings
episodes.summary: Oniyasha and Zojiro have decided to collaborate, but that doesn't mean everyone is happy about it. Meanwhile, Chiharu struggles with feelings of inadequacy.

episodes.title: A World Overflowing
episodes.summary: Oniyasha and Zojiro take the stage for the final round, but the competition will end in a way no one predicted.
